### Biomimikriia

Groups: 2 · Skills: 8

[index.ts](../../../content/engineering/data/skills/biomimicry/index.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Nature-inspired engineering abstracts useful functional strategies from living systems and subjects technical adaptations to testing. Evolution is not intentional design, and merely studying an organism is not itself an engineering competency.

### Elektr jäne elektronika injeneriiasy

Groups: 5 · Skills: 27

[index.ts](../../../content/engineering/data/skills/electricalAndElectronicEngineering/index.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Circuits and electronic hardware distribute power, process signals and connect physical controls to useful outputs. The subject here is device architecture and correct component integration, not the scientific derivation of electromagnetic laws.

[protectiveSurfaceTreatments.ts](../../../content/engineering/data/skills/materialsAndConnections/surfacesAndFit/protectiveSurfaceTreatments.ts)

[index.ts](../../../content/engineering/data/skills/mechanismsAndMachines/index.ts)

### Qauıpsızdık, tūraqtylyq jäne jauapkerşılık

Groups: 3 · Skills: 14

[index.ts](../../../content/engineering/data/skills/safetySustainabilityAndResponsibility/index.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Engineering decisions affect people, resources and ecosystems throughout a product's service life. This domain examines foreseeable hazards, life-cycle choices and accountable technical judgment without turning an untested model into a safety certification.

**User-friendly description (kk):** İnjenerlık şeşımderdıñ uaqyt öte qauıpsızdıkke, resurstarğa jäne qoğamğa qalai äser etetının zertte.

Skills: 5

[index.ts](../../../content/engineering/data/skills/safetySustainabilityAndResponsibility/ethicsAndPublicEffects/index.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Technical solutions create benefits and burdens for users, maintainers, neighbors and communities; limitations must be disclosed.

**User-friendly description (kk):** İnjenerlık būiymdar äser etetın barlyq adam aldyndağy jauapkerşılıktı qarastyr.

[communicateDesignLimitations.ts](../../../content/engineering/data/skills/safetySustainabilityAndResponsibility/ethicsAndPublicEffects/communicateDesignLimitations.ts)

[evaluateEnvironmentalImpactsOfADesign.ts](../../../content/engineering/data/skills/safetySustainabilityAndResponsibility/ethicsAndPublicEffects/evaluateEnvironmentalImpactsOfADesign.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Consider pollution, habitat disruption and resource burdens beyond the immediate operation of the intended product.

**Methodological description (English):** Consider foreseeable distribution of access, inconvenience, displacement or other effects on people beyond direct purchasers.

**User-friendly description (kk):** Tehnikalyq önım adamdardyñ ömırı men mümkındıkterıne qalai äser etuı mümkın ekenın bağala.

[justifyResponsibleDesignDecisions.ts](../../../content/engineering/data/skills/safetySustainabilityAndResponsibility/ethicsAndPublicEffects/justifyResponsibleDesignDecisions.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Explain how safety, access, resource use and cost influenced a choice.

**User-friendly description (kk):** İnjenerlık tañdaulardy däleldermen, qauıpsızdıkpen jäne äleumettık saldarmen negızde.
